name: vue-skills
description: A collection of skills for Vue.js development.

plugins.name: vue-skills-bundle
plugins.description: Install all Vue.js skills at once, including best practices, testing, router, Pinia, JSX, Options API, debug guides, and composable patterns.

plugins.name: create-adaptable-composable
plugins.description: Create a Vue 3.3+ composable that accepts plain values, refs, or getters when appropriate. Normalize inputs with toValue() inside reactive effects, and require a writable Ref or explicit setter when changes must flow back to the caller. Use this skill when user asks for an adaptable or reusable composable.

plugins.name: vue-best-practices
plugins.description: Vue 3 development guidance. Prefer Composition API with <script setup> for new full-application SFC work when it fits the project; preserve existing Options API and JavaScript conventions. Use for Vue-specific implementation or review tasks.

plugins.name: vue-debug-guides
plugins.description: Vue 3 debugging and error handling for runtime errors, warnings, async failures, and SSR/hydration issues. Use when diagnosing or fixing Vue issues.

plugins.name: vue-jsx-best-practices
plugins.description: JSX syntax in Vue (e.g., class vs className, JSX plugin config).

plugins.name: vue-options-api-best-practices
plugins.description: Vue 3 Options API style (data(), methods, this context). Each reference shows Options API solution only.

plugins.name: vue-pinia-best-practices
plugins.description: Pinia stores, state management patterns, store setup, and reactivity with stores.

plugins.name: vue-router-best-practices
plugins.description: Vue Router 4 patterns, navigation guards, route params, and route-component lifecycle interactions.

plugins.name: vue-testing-best-practices
plugins.description: Use for Vue.js testing. Covers Vitest, Vue Test Utils, component testing, mocking, testing patterns, and Playwright for E2E testing.
